text.tspan: No marker stripping or flag weakening
latest-state semantics require an actual guarded source contract.
Immutable snapshots are not latest-state claims. New evaluated admission, protected issue and phase guards need owner qualification.
Reject drift and erroring policy IDs

g.text: Same fixed binding / no expiry extension
